description: This Java class defines a PurgeJob responsible for removing a specific JobSandbox entity and its related data within the OFBiz framework. It extends AbstractJob and implements Serializable, managing job lifecycle states and priority.

classes.name: PurgeJob
classes.description: A job class responsible for purging a job sandbox entity in the OFBiz framework, managing its lifecycle states and priority.

methods.name: PurgeJob
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PurgeJob with a given GenericValue representing the job to be purged.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the purge operation, checking the job state and removing the job via JobUtil.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the job is in a valid state for execution (created state).

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Removes the job from the queue, ensuring it is in the queued state.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the job priority, which is LOW.
